page.overview:
Who is Ezlo?

While trapped in his cursed cap form, Ezlo takes on the look of a humble green cap — strikingly similar to the very one Link is famous for wearing — yet there's something unmistakably alive about it. Nestled into the fabric is a curious, bird-like face, complete with a pair of sharp, watchful eyes and a large, prominent yellow beak that gives him an air of grumpy wisdom rather than ordinary headwear. Two small leaf-like protrusions, almost resembling stubby wings or ears, poke out from either side of the cap, hinting at the magical, sentient being hidden within. Despite his unassuming size and plain coloring, there's a certain dignified, ancient quality to his design — a visual reminder that this is no ordinary piece of clothing, but a once-great sorcerer bound by a cruel transformation, forced to ride atop the hero's head until his curse can be broken.

Before meeting , was a renowned craftsman and sage who was working on the , a that would grant the wishes of its wearer. The was intended as a gift for the , but when he finished it, his apprentice (who was also a at the time) stole it from his work desk and donned it, using its power to turn himself into a powerful sorcerer. attempted to stop , but was unsuccessful. used the power he had received from the to place a on , transforming him into a creature resembling a mix between a green hat and a bird. pursued into through the , leading to his meeting with .

After defeats in , is transformed back into his original form. He tells to combine her power with the in order to undo all the damage done by . Before the closes for another hundred years, gives a green hat similar to the form he took while under 's , remarking that it is the first time he has seen him wearing one and that it suits him.
